import sqlite3

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from service.config import Settings
from service.db.session import add_missing_columns, build_engine
from service.main import create_app

URL = "https://example.com/limited"


def test_link_stops_working_after_max_clicks(client):
    r = client.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": URL, "max_clicks": 2})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.json()["max_clicks"] == 2
    code = r.json()["code"]
    assert client.get(f"/{code}").status_code == 302
    assert client.get(f"/{code}").status_code == 302
    third = client.get(f"/{code}")
    assert third.status_code == 404
    assert "click limit" in third.json()["detail"]
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/urls/{code}/stats").json()["total_clicks"] == 2


def test_unlimited_links_are_unchanged(client):
    r = client.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": URL})
    assert r.json()["max_clicks"] is None
    code = r.json()["code"]
    assert all(client.get(f"/{code}").status_code == 302 for _ in range(5))


def test_max_clicks_validation(client):
    assert client.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": URL, "max_clicks": 0}).status_code == 422
    big = {"url": URL, "max_clicks": 1_000_001}
    assert client.post("/api/v1/urls", json=big).status_code == 422


def test_click_limited_links_are_not_served_from_cache(client, app):
    code = client.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": URL, "max_clicks": 5}).json()["code"]
    client.get(f"/{code}")
    assert app.state.cache.get(code) is None


def test_idempotent_replay_of_deleted_link_returns_410(client):
    headers = {"Idempotency-Key": "replay-after-delete"}
    code = client.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": URL}, headers=headers).json()["code"]
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/urls/{code}").status_code == 204
    replay = client.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": URL}, headers=headers)
    assert replay.status_code == 410
    assert "deleted" in replay.json()["detail"]


def test_existing_database_is_migrated_on_startup(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "old.db"
    with sqlite3.connect(db) as conn:  # schema as created by v1, without max_clicks
        conn.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE urls (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code VARCHAR(32) UNIQUE NOT NULL, "
            "long_url TEXT NOT NULL, is_custom BOOLEAN NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME, "
            "expires_at DATETIME, is_deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, click_count INTEGER NOT NULL, "
            "last_accessed_at DATETIME)"
        )
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO urls (code, long_url, is_custom, created_at, is_deleted, click_count) "
            "VALUES ('legacy1', 'https://example.com/old', 0, '2026-01-01 00:00:00', 0, 7)"
        )
    app = create_app(Settings(database_url=f"sqlite:///{db}"))
    c = TestClient(app, follow_redirects=False)
    assert c.get("/legacy1").status_code == 302  # old rows keep working
    assert c.get("/api/v1/urls/legacy1").json()["max_clicks"] is None
    assert add_missing_columns(app.state.engine) == []  # idempotent
    app.state.engine.dispose()


def test_migration_refuses_not_null_columns(tmp_path):
    import pytest
    from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, MetaData, Table

    from service.db import session as session_module

    engine = build_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'x.db'}")
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.exec_driver_sql("CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")
    md = MetaData()
    Table("t", md, Column("id", Integer, primary_key=True), Column("n", Integer, nullable=False))

    class FakeBase:
        metadata = md

    original = session_module.Base
    session_module.Base = FakeBase
    try:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="manual migration"):
            add_missing_columns(engine)
    finally:
        session_module.Base = original
        engine.dispose()
